class.name: OcgIgescontrolWriter
class.brief_description: This class creates and writes IGES files from CAS.CADE models. An IGES file can be written to an existing IGES file or to a new one. The translation can be performed in one or several operations. Each translation operation outputs a distinct root entity in the IGES file. To write an IGES file it is possible to use the following sequence: To modify the IGES file header or to change translation parameters it is necessary to use class Interface_Static (see IGESParameters and GeneralParameters).

The translation can be performed in one or several ! operations. Each translation operation ! outputs a distinct root entity in the IGES file. ! IGESParameters and GeneralParameters).

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a writer object with the default unit (millimeters) and write mode (Face). IGESControl_Writer (const Standard_CString unit, const Standard_Integer modecr = 0);

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a writer with given values for units and for write mode. theUnit may be any unit that is accepted by the IGES standard. By default, it is the millimeter. theModecr defines the write mode and may be: - 0: Faces (default) - 1: BRep.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a writer object with the prepared IGES model theModel in write mode. theModecr defines the write mode and may be: - 0: Faces (default) - 1: BRep.

method.name: Model
method.description: Returns the IGES model to be written in output.

method.name: SetTransferProcess
method.description: Returns/Sets the TransferProcess : it contains final results and if some, check messages

method.name: AddShape
method.description: Translates a Shape to IGES Entities and adds them to the model Returns True if done, False if Shape not suitable for IGES or null

method.name: AddGeom
method.description: Translates a Geometry (Surface or Curve) to IGES Entities and adds them to the model Returns True if done, False if geom is neither a Surface or a Curve suitable for IGES or is null

method.name: AddEntity
method.description: Adds an IGES entity (and the ones it references) to the model

method.name: ComputeModel
method.description: Computes the entities found in the model, which is ready to be written. This contrasts with the default computation of headers only.

method.name: Write_1
method.description: Computes then writes the model to an OStream Returns True when done, false in case of error

method.name: Write_2
method.description: Prepares and writes an IGES model either to an OStream, S or to a file name,CString. Returns True if the operation was performed correctly and False if an error occurred (for instance, if the processor could not create the file).
